confidence_notes: Medium for food and drink, low for accommodation. Restaurant and drink anchors come from aggregator cost-of-living and price-index pages (Expatica/Numbeo-derived, MyLifeElsewhere, Expatistan). Several are dated or thin, and restaurant prices are assumed before tax and tip. The cocktail anchor ($18) rests on one thin Expatistan sample of 7 price points. No by-the-glass wine price was found, so wine_glass (about 1.75 times the beer anchor) is a derived estimate, not a direct price. The inexpensive meal anchor is food-only, adjusted down from a roughly $25 meal-with-drink figure. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season and were not checked against live listings or booking pages; no accommodation searches were run. FX: I could not confirm the RBA F11.1 table itself. The 0.6976 value for 2026-11-03 comes from a third-party report of the RBA 4pm reference, cross-checked against market reports near that level. A later RBA observation (up to 2026-11-19) may exist. Verify against the RBA table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Food and drink anchors are based on Boston-specific aggregated price sources. Accommodation anchors are a holistic model estimate informed by Boston's status as a high-cost US city in peak summer season.
